figurative_meaning_en: Gradually changing hands and returning to the original owner
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার দেওয়া বইটা হাত-ফেরতা হয়ে ফিরে এসেছে।
ব্যবসায়ে অনেক সময় মাল হাত-ফেরতা হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: The book I gave away has come back to me after changing hands.
In business, goods often return to the original owner after passing through several hands.
note: This idiom reflects the cyclical nature of possessions in Bengali folk wisdom.
